checks: The real ForYou component renders the authenticated hybrid feed and explains topic groups and community.
DEMO runs real K-Means over synthetic public topics, separate from the real feed, without actionable profile links.
Changing interests changes people and content; campus and nearby selections preserve geographic scope.
Demo failure preserves the feed and offers a working retry.
A pending demo cannot reopen itself after the user closes it.
The feature fits 320/390/768/1440px and light, dark and Calm themes.
scope: Real React and HTTP client to real Express/Python; synthetic identity and Supabase responses. No real user records, writes, voice or Gemini calls.
